title: The most powerful app in app store(Самое мощное приложение в апп сторе)
body: Спасибо Японцам за такой бесплатный шедевр.Thank you Japanese for this amazing free app
author: Agulec21

title: 怠け者に優しいアプリです
body: まだ二週間目ですが、私を見捨てないでくれてありがとう。ダウンロードした理由は、このアプリの作者のゆるいモードがいいなぁと感じたからでした。ユーザーとの距離が近い感じ。頑張らない継続アプリのおかげで、楽しく達成出来そうです。
author: cappaya

title: Missing this app
body: I started with this app, very recently and loved it suddenly today I don’t see any English words, so I have to uninstall it. It was very simple and easy to use with minimalistic approach. Dear developer if you are reading this, thanks for all your efforts. And if possible please bring it back in English.
author: Sasikumar Karunakaran

title: I like the concept
body: I really like minimalistic apps like this that does one job well. However, it kept bothering me with notification saying that I haven't done my routine yet, even if I have already entered one for the day. I'd use it again if it works properly.
author: aikat711

title: Pretty good, missing some advanced settings
body: Automatically resets after 2 days of failing.. wish I could change that setting to my own preference. Pretty simple to use though.
author: campbelldavid

title: Nice app!
body:
Just the type of app I was looking for!
However, I would love to be able to set more than 1 habit!!!👍🏽👍🏽👍🏽
(Would definitely update my review to 5 stars if the app was updated to include that!)
Thank you!
